checks.meaning: Customers held out in the planned share. A failure means the split or the logging is broken, and that offer's number cannot be used until it is fixed.
Forecasts shown at approval against what the offers measured. Outside the band, the quotes owners approve are off and the model needs retraining.

checks.threshold: paused and probably losing together under 25%
checks.meaning: Share of offers by weekly verdict. Many losing offers means the selection is letting bad versions through.

All running offers' control groups together say how far the model really misses, against the error it states. Above 1.5 the model is worse than it claims: widen the ranges and retrain. Each restaurant's own number may lean on the model (median weight on its own control group 0.15) only while this holds.

checks.threshold: at most 4 weeks (rebuilt at each renewal)
checks.meaning: Weeks since each offer's decision table was built. An old table serves customers on an old snapshot of their history.
